effect.name: Dream Filter (Switch)
effect.description: This shader creates an effect like in a dream.
effect.author: Foxioo

parameter.name: /* Foxioo's Dream Filter (Switch) Shader | 2026.09.05 */
parameter.description: This shader creates an effect like in a dream.

parameter.name: Blending Mode
parameter.description: This variable determines which color will be the basis for modification. Set to 0 means it will be the texture of the object and set to 1 it will be the background.

parameter.name: Mixing
parameter.description: This variable is responsible for the visibility of the effect.

parameter.name: Size
parameter.description: This variable specifies the filter size in pixels.

parameter.name: Quality
parameter.description: This variable determines the quality; the higher the value, the more work the GPU does.
